tonight.title: The Odyssey
tonight.why: Kick off your weekend with pure, unadulterated presidential mayhem as "The Beast" unleashes its armored fury against a coup; it's the kind of high-octane absurdity that makes you glad you're just watching.

releases.title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
releases.take: Panem's prequel serves up another round of dystopian child combat, proving some traditions are just *never* a good idea.

releases.title: Avengers: Doomsday
releases.take: When three universes collide, you know the CGI budget went supernova, but let's hope the plot does too.

releases.title: Guarding Stars
releases.take: It's *The Bodyguard* meets *Hallmark Christmas*, proving even action heroes need a little holiday romance (and maybe a new security detail).

critic.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
critic.blurb: For those craving an epic journey that truly tests the human spirit and the limits of divine patience, "The Odyssey" delivers a timeless tale of perseverance against impossible odds. It's a reminder that some stories are legendary for a reason.
